name: io.github.clipugc/clipugc
title: ClipUGC
description: Create AI influencer characters, looks, video clips and merged UGC app ads with ClipUGC.

packageArguments.description: Start the stdio MCP server (the same binary is also the clipugc CLI)

environmentVariables.name: CLIPUGC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ClipUGC API key from the dashboard (API Keys). Optional when `clipugc auth login` was run on this machine.

environmentVariables.name: CLIPUGC_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (default https://clipugc.com/api/v2). Only for self-hosted or local instances.
